title: Org Coding Standards
tagline: A shared source of truth for your team’s coding standards and review rules.
summary: Every agent consults the same canonical standards
Maintainers publish updates through a shared workspace
Read-only mounts receive standards without publishing agent edits
whyItMatters: Coding standards go stale when agents never consult them. This recipe gives agents a shared set of rules and a protocol for reading and citing them before implementation and review. A read-only mount keeps a consumer’s local edits from changing the shared standards.
firstPrompt: Summarize every standard in this workspace in one paragraph each.
